notes: Reference date 2018-03-13; reference period 2017-18. All documents are undated web pages; their Wayback captures (2017-05-14 to 2018-09-15) and footer years (2017, 2018) fall in or bracket the reference academic year; the III. Leaves capture is 2018-09-15, and its version note records identical text in the 2016-09-22 capture.

Sources: 2018_00_link (HR leave-policies summary page with navigation); 2018_01 (handbook ch. 4 contents and I. Faculty Benefits: retirement, life, LTD, medical, dental, FSA); 2018_03 (handbook ch. 3 contents and I. Academic Freedom only; holds no leave policy); 2018_04 (handbook ch. 4 III. Leaves); 2018_05 (provost's maternity-leave guidelines); 2018_06 (handbook ch. 2 IV, tenure criteria and probationary period).

Governing documents: the Faculty Handbook (III. Leaves; IV.B probationary period; I.C LTD) and the Office of the Provost's Guidelines for Maternity Leave, which implement the handbook's maternity leave for the campus (V3c: a provost's directive for the campus is the institution's policy). The HR leave-policies page is a summary; it restates the guidelines and FML, and is the only saved source for the birth/adoption tenure-clock extension (c5, summary_only) and the personal-reasons leave (c9, summary_only).

Member's path (U8): an academic-year (nine-month) tenure-stream faculty member, who does not accrue sick or annual leave, takes the guidelines' eight paid weeks (c2). Calendar-year faculty accrue sick and annual leave (c10, named group) and are expected to use it first, with additional paid time under the handbook to reach eight weeks; that path is recorded in c10's note, not linked.

Birth parent chain: teaching relief for the semester of the leave (c3, discretionary) containing the paid maternity leave, 8 weeks (c2); the handbook maternity leave of up to 6 months (c1) starts with c2; FMLA 12 workweeks (c4) runs concurrently with c1 (eight paid weeks, then up to four unpaid FML weeks per the guidelines).

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c4) only; plus the tenure-clock extension for birth or adoption (c5, summary_only) and the general tenure-clock provisions (c6, c7, general_purpose). No institutional parental leave or relief for a non-birth parent is stated.

Pay of the handbook maternity leave: the handbook's footnote ('Temporary faculty members with appointments for less than one calendar year will not receive compensation for leaves granted under this section') implies compensation for other faculty during maternity or sick leave, but no pay level or paid length is stated; the guidelines pay eight weeks and convert to unpaid status at the end of the approved paid period. Flagged ambiguous on c1; whether the rest of the six months is paid sick leave is not determinable from the saved sources.
Handbook sick leave for illness (III.A.1, same sentence as maternity leave) is recorded within c1 (one provision: 'Maternity or Sick Leave'); for a birth the maternity leave governs.

Not components: sabbatical leave (faculty and administrative), funeral leave, military leave, jury duty leave, annual leave for staff, holidays, insurance continuation during unpaid or FMLA leave (the University continues its share of health premiums during FMLA leave: 'However, the University will continue to pay its portion for pre-existing health coverage for the faculty member who is on FMLA leave.').

Documents cited but not saved: the Tenure-Clock Extension Policy (HR page); the HR Policy Manual and Employee Handbook (HR page navigation); the Disability and Life Insurance Plans page and LTD plan document; Faculty Handbook ch. 3 sections VI (Faculty Work Loads), VIII (Sabbatical Leaves) and XV (Academic Calendar & Compensation Periods); ch. 2 sections other than IV (e.g. XIV Termination and Severance); the medical plan description booklet; the HR FML approval process materials.
